name: FLOWERS -Le volume sur hiver-
source:
Suou/[spoiler]Mayuri[/spoiler]:  "Is there someone in your life whom you want to be with, forevermore?"

"Tell me the key necessary to arrive at the [spoiler]Goddess of Truth[/spoiler],"

challenged Suou after becoming [spoiler]the president of Council of Nicaea[/spoiler] and overcoming the trials from [spoiler]Yatsushiro Yuzuriha[/spoiler].  As promised, the name given was "[spoiler]The Seven Wonders of the Beginning of the End[/spoiler]," directly linking [spoiler]Kousaka Mayuri, her amity who disappeared in Spring[/spoiler].

A number of even more bizarre events arise in Saint Angraecum Academy during the season of Winter.

With the help of her friends, Shirahane Suou will stand up against many obstacles, but…  the words she prayed to God, "Please forget about me," still overwhelms her.

The reemergence of her step-mom's shadow, passing thoughts, unexpected continuations…  Just what will it all bring about to Suou?  

The final wintry season will melt everything away…

[Translated from [url=http://www.gungnir.co.jp/lily/flowers4/flowers4_story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
苏枋／[spoiler]真由理[/spoiler]：“你的生命中，有想永远和你在一起的人吗？”

成为[spoiler]尼西亚议会会长[/spoiler]、克服[spoiler]八代柚叶[/spoiler]的考验后，苏枋挑战道：“告诉我抵达[spoiler]真理女神[/spoiler]所需的钥匙。”正如约定，得到的名字是“[spoiler]终焉之始的七大奇迹[/spoiler]”，直接指向春天消失的[spoiler]挚友高坂真由理[/spoiler]。

圣安格莱卡学院在冬季迎来一系列更加诡异的事件。

在朋友帮助下，白羽苏枋挺身面对重重障碍，但她向神祈求的“请忘了我”仍然压倒着她。

继母身影重新出现、转瞬即逝的思绪、意料之外的后续……这一切究竟会给苏枋带来什么？

最后一个冬季，将融化一切……

[译自[url=http://www.gungnir.co.jp/lily/flowers4/flowers4_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
